declarations.name: Causal.IsSpacetimeExtension.not_futureBoundaryChart_of_flrwType
declarations.notes: Exactly the time reversal of IsSpacetimeExtension.not_pastBoundaryChart_of_flrwType (:478). The binders are the same and in the same order: [T2Space M] [SecondCountableTopology M] hι hcac hfoc hcaus hA hB Ũ p, with the same [Nonempty N] variable. There is no added hypothesis. The auditor's probe checked these facts. (i) FutureBoundaryChart C W Ũ p = C.dual.PastBoundaryChart W Ũ p by rfl. (ii) hι.dual.rangeOpens = hι.rangeOpens by rfl. So (¬ C.FutureBoundaryChart hι.rangeOpens Ũ p) = (¬ C.dual.PastBoundaryChart hι.dual.rangeOpens Ũ p) by rfl. (iii) (A⁻) for CN is equivalent to (A) for CN.dual, proved in both directions, so there is no strengthening. (iv) (B⁻) for CN is equivalent to (B) for CN.dual (dual_isCauchySurfaceOn). (v) The three nodes are self-dual (dual_causallyArcConnectedOn, dual_futureOneConnected, dual_isCausal). (A⁻) and (B⁻) have the shape of the open-set reversal Causality.not_futureBoundaryChart_of_flrwType at W = ⊤, with `= univ` as in the past corollary. The hand-typed expected statement elaborates against @IsSpacetimeExtension.not_futureBoundaryChart_of_flrwType. The statement matches the target's wording in roadmap.toml clause by clause.

findings.what: The REPORT says that no Lean declaration inhabits FutureBoundaryChart. It concludes that the time-reversed theorems (the open-set one, the closed-ambient A and B forms, and the two new ones) have witnesses of consistency only, not of non-vacuity. It leaves a layer-3 instance to the planner, and it proposes that the ladder's past_boundary_chart note record that FutureBoundaryChart has no Lean instance. That is not so. FutureBoundaryChart C is C.dual.PastBoundaryChart by definition, and Causality.dual_dual is rfl. So the existing layer-3 declaration Causal.minkowski_pastBoundaryChart already inhabits FutureBoundaryChart. The auditor's probe confirms that `example (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) : (minkowski n).dual.FutureBoundaryChart (minkowskiPosHalfSpace n) (minkowskiChartBox n) 0 := minkowski_pastBoundaryChart hn` elaborates. The time reversals are therefore non-vacuous already. Only the {t < 0} chart for `minkowski n` itself, through the time reflection, is missing. The REPORT does name 'Minkowski space's dual causality' as a route, but it calls that work still to be done. The statement is a programme note to the planner and keeper, not a claim of an error in the paper, and no Lean statement or proof depends on it.
findings.fix: Reword findings[2]: FutureBoundaryChart is inhabited at (minkowski n).dual by minkowski_pastBoundaryChart hn, by rfl (Causality.dual_dual), so the time-reversed theorems are not vacuous.
